overview: 针对四足机器人运动中能效与鲁棒性难以兼顾的问题，本文提出了一种分层强化学习（HRL）框架。该方法将关节层面的高频运动执行与低频步态适应解耦，旨在显式最小化运输成本（CoT）。通过三阶段的Isaac模拟训练，该策略实现了零样本的模拟到现实迁移，并能在不同地形和速度下自动适应步态，在提升能效的同时保持了运动的稳健性。

highlights.text: 提出分层强化学习框架，将关节运动执行与步态适应解耦，有效降低了运输成本（CoT）。
highlights.evidence: In this work, we propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework that separates a high-frequency policy for stable and robust joint-level motion execution from low-frequency gait adaptation that explicitly minimizes the cost of transport (CoT).

highlights.text: 该方法实现了零样本Sim-to-Real迁移，在多种地形上表现出更好的运动稳健性与能效。
highlights.evidence: The three-stage Isaac-based training procedure enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer with improved tracking accuracy, robustness, and energy efficiency.

highlights.text: 分层策略能够根据速度自动调整步态，并在广泛的速度范围内降低了运输成本。
highlights.evidence: The learned hierarchy exhibits automatic speed-dependent gait adaptation, transitioning from pacing at low speeds to trotting at higher speeds.
